protocol:
Luminex Bead Coupling
Vortex the bead stock suspension to yield a homogeneous bead suspension.
Dissolve approximately 10 mg each of EDC and S-NHS into 2 microcentrifuge tubes and resuspend in deionized water at 50 mg/mL.
Centrifuge the 100 μl bead suspension at 10,000 x g. 
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 80 μl activation buffer.
Add 10 μl of S-NHS solution and 10 μl of EDC solution to the bead suspension.
Incubate with agitation at room temperature in the dark at roughly 900 rpm.
Dilute your protein stock solution with coupling buffer to a concentration of 0.1 mg/ml in a volume of 100 μl.
Optimal coupling may occur at a concentration within 25-250 μg/ml.
Note the protein stock cannot have any other amine groups present.
Centrifuge the beads at 10,000 x g. 
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Add the diluted protein solution.
Agitate the tube with activated beads and protein solution overnight at 4C at roughly 900 rpm in the dark (wrapped in foil).
Centrifuge the beads at 10,000 x g. 
Discard supernatant.
Wash the beads three times with PBS/1% BSA.
Resuspend the bead pellet in 1 ml PBS/1% BSA.
Determine bead concentration using Luminex and adjust amount of stock used accordingly.

parameters.container: tube with activated beads and protein solution

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
vortex(container='bead stock suspension tube', reagent='bead stock suspension', goal='homogeneous bead suspension')
dissolve(container='2 microcentrifuge tubes', reagent='EDC (10 mg), S-NHS (10 mg)', solvent='deionized water', final concentration='50 mg/mL')
centrifuge(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='100 μl bead suspension', volume='100 μl', speed='10,000 x g')
remove(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='supernatant', method='carefully')
resuspend(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='beads', volume='80 μl', buffer='activation buffer')
add(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='S-NHS solution', volume='10 μl')
add(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='EDC solution', volume='10 μl')
incubate(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='beads + S-NHS + EDC', temperature='room temperature', speed='900 rpm', light='in the dark')
dilute(reagent='protein stock solution', volume='100 μl', buffer='coupling buffer', final concentration='0.1 mg/ml')
centrifuge(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='beads', speed='10,000 x g')
remove(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='supernatant', method='carefully')
add(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='diluted protein solution', volume='100 μl')
agitate(container='tube with activated beads and protein solution', reagent='activated beads + protein solution', temperature='4C', duration='overnight', speed='900 rpm', light='in the dark (wrapped in foil)')
centrifuge(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='beads', speed='10,000 x g')
discard(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='supernatant')
wash(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='beads', buffer='PBS/1% BSA', times=3)
resuspend(container='bead suspension tube', reagent='bead pellet', volume='1 ml', buffer='PBS/1% BSA')

### MANUAL SECTION ###

# MANUAL: adjust (reagent: amount of stock used, other: {'based on': 'bead concentration'})
